column1: # Contest and puzzle ciphers for measuring automatic solving (`cryptok contest run`).
# Columns (tab separated): id, contest, type, cipher, expected, hints, notes
#   type      the cipher family (what a human would call it); used only to report whether the winning solver matches
#   cipher    letters, or @path to a file (non-letters such as Kryptos' '?' are kept for transposition solvers)
#   expected  known plaintext, compared from the start (a prefix is fine); running keys count a match in either stream
#   hints     '-' or key=value pairs separated by ';' (alphabet=KRYPTOS gives the solver a Quagmire III keyword, an assisted case)
# Add real contest ciphers below the `real` rows. Do not invent ciphertext: only entries with a published solution belong here.
# Copyrighted keys (DC20) stay in bench/private/; the cipher and plaintext themselves are in the public record.
